svg.aria-label: Terminal: # the code index (default), after npm install | $ claude mcp add code-context -- npx code-context ./context.db | # or the sprint process on top | $ claude mcp add code-context -- npx code-context-sprint ./context.db | # without a local install (the index) | $ claude mcp add code-context -- npx -y vlm-code-context-mcp ./context.db | # remove | $ claude mcp remove code-context
